description: Dart source file defining the HospitalProvider class, which manages hospital profile data and job postings, with methods for loading profiles, creating jobs, and removing jobs, utilizing Flutter's ChangeNotifier for state management.

classes.name: HospitalProvider
classes.description: A class extending ChangeNotifier that provides hospital profile management and job posting functionalities, notifying listeners upon changes.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Simulates loading a hospital profile asynchronously and updates the internal profile state.

methods.name: createJob
methods.description: Creates a new job post, adds it to the list, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: removeJob
methods.description: Removes a job post by ID and updates the state accordingly.
